headlines.title: 서울 아파트거래 22%가 6억 이하 …정책대출 커트라인에 몰렸다
headlines.summary: 1만709건 거래…전년동기比 11% 급등 6억 초과하면 디딤돌대출 등 못 받아 매수세에 가격↑…“저가 아파트 소멸” 올해 서울에서 거래된 아파트 5채 중 1채 이상이 ‘6억원 이하’인 것으로 나타났다. 전셋값 급등에 대출 문턱마저 높아지자, 정책대출을 받을 수 있는 시세 6억원 이하의 집으로 매수세가 몰린 것으로 풀이된다.

headlines.title: 거래 말랐는데 신고가는 속출 …“ 2022년 급락장과는 다르다 ”
headlines.summary: 서울 아파트 거래량 석달새 62.8% 급감 역대 최고가 이어져…서울 외곽 급속 확산 가격하락 앞서 거래량 감소 과거 사례에도 “공급 부족·대출 제한에 시장 영향 제한적” 서울 아파트 매매 거래가 급감한 가운데, 신고가 거래는 곳곳에서 속출하고 있다. 하지만 시장에선 거래량 감소가 급격한 가격 조정으로 이어지긴 어려울 것으로 내다보고 있다.

headlines.title: 강남 넘어 오금동도 공사비 3.3㎡당 1000만원 육박
headlines.summary: ‘천정부지’ 치솟는 서울 재건축 공사비 송파구 오금현대 평당 962만원 제시 목동4·13단지 등 곳곳서 1000만원 공사비 급등에 분양가 1년새 34% 상승 반포·여의도·압구정 등 한강변 핵심 정비사업지를 넘어 서울 곳곳에서 3.3㎡(평)당 1000만원 안팎의 공사비 사례가 나타나고 있다.

headlines.title: 인구감소 · 주택거래 둔화 … 8월 이동자 수 53년 만에 최소
headlines.summary: ▲ 서울 아파트 인구 감소 흐름에 주택 거래까지 둔화하면서 8월 국내 이동자 수가 같은 달 기준으로 53년 만에 가장 적었습니다. 국가데이터처가 오늘(23일) 발표한 '8월 국내인구이동 통계'를 보면 지난달 국내 이동자 수는 47만1천명으로 1년 전보다 4.5%(2만2천명) 감소했습니다.

headlines.title: 7월 출생아 2만4천명, 7년 만에 최대 … 연간 누적 17만명 넘어
headlines.summary: '하반기도 반등 흐름'…1∼7월 누적 출생아 증가율 역대 최고 병원 신생아실 [연합뉴스 자료사진] (세종=연합뉴스) 송정은 기자 = 올해 7월 태어난 아기가 7년 만에 가장 많은 수준을 기록했다. 출생아 수 증가 흐름이 이어지며 올해 연간 누적 출생아는 17만명을 넘었다.

headlines.title: [기자수첩] 2022년 소환 한 주택 공급절벽 정쟁
headlines.summary: "(주택가격이 급등한) 단기적 원인으로 보면 2022년, 즉 윤석열 정권이 들어서고 오세훈 시장이 당선된 해부터 허가와 착공 건수가 절반으로 줄었다. 이런 상황에서 부동산 토지거래 허가를 풀어서 특정 지역의 집값이 폭등했다" 이재명 대통령은 최근 기자회견에서 주택가격이 크게 오른 배경을 묻는 말에 전 정권과 야당 출신 현 서울시장의 정책을 탓했다.

key_headlines.title: ADB Raises South Korea's 2026 Growth Forecast to 3.2% on Strong AI Semiconductor Exports
key_headlines.summary: The Asian Development Bank upgraded Korea's economic growth projection from 2.6% to 3.2% for 2026, citing robust semiconductor exports and recovering consumer spending. The 2027 growth forecast was also adjusted upward from 2.0% to 2.3%.

key_headlines.title: Won-Dollar Exchange Rate Falls Below 1,350 Won on Oil Price Decline and Export Strength
key_headlines.summary: The Korean won strengthened as oil prices declined due to eased US-Iran tensions and Saudi Arabia's expanded crude exports. Continued semiconductor export momentum also helped cap the dollar-won exchange rate's upside.

key_headlines.title: 22% of Seoul Apartment Transactions Below 600 Million Won Due to Policy Loan Cutoffs
key_headlines.summary: Over one-fifth of Seoul apartment sales involved properties priced at 600 million won or below, driven by buyers clustering around the policy loan eligibility threshold. This trend reflects higher borrowing costs and stricter lending regulations.

key_headlines.title: South Korea Pursues Eight Nuclear Power Plants Including Korean-Type APR1400 in US Market
key_headlines.summary: Korea and the US are jointly developing plans to build six Westinghouse AP1000 reactors and two Korean-made APR1400 reactors in the United States. Additional costs and workforce availability pose major challenges to the ambitious project.

key_headlines.title: Customs Agency Eliminates Whistleblower Reward Caps to Maximize Reporting Effectiveness
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's Customs Service abolished the upper limit on whistleblower rewards and introduced a progressive payment system offering up to three times the previous maximum incentive. The measure aims to strengthen voluntary reporting of smuggling and customs violations.

sections.Hot Economy News: The Asian Development Bank has significantly upgraded South Korea's economic growth outlook to 3.2% for 2026, representing the second consecutive upward revision driven primarily by strong AI semiconductor exports and recovering consumer spending. The won-dollar exchange rate has strengthened to the 1,350 won level as oil prices declined and Korean semiconductor exports maintained momentum. Meanwhile, the real estate market shows distinctive trends with approximately 22% of Seoul apartment transactions clustering below the 600 million won policy loan threshold, indicating both structural challenges in housing affordability and government lending regulation impacts.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The ADB's revised growth forecast reflects improving economic fundamentals, with Korea's 2027 projection also raised from 2.0% to 2.3%. Inflation expectations remain stable at 2.7% for 2026. The US Federal Reserve's recent rate hike to 3.75-4.00% has implications for Korea's external financing environment. Domestically, policymakers face challenges from elevated housing costs, shifting tenure preferences from jeonse to monthly rent, and the need to support business investment in advanced industries.
sections.Financial Markets: The Korean stock market rebounded above 7,100 points following positive US market signals, with semiconductor stocks like Samsung Electronics rising over 2%. The US Treasury yield curve gap reached its narrowest level since March 2025, signaling potential economic slowdown concerns and uncertainty about future Fed rate decisions. Foreign exchange markets reflect reduced risk premiums, with the won strengthening against the dollar amid easing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korean battery manufacturers are developing LFP (lithium iron phosphate) technologies to compete with Chinese competitors in the low-cost EV and energy storage markets. Daewoo Engineering & Construction is expanding its global nuclear and energy infrastructure business leveraging 50 years of overseas experience. Agricultural technology startups are emerging with AI-powered autonomous farming robots aimed at automating farm operations. Plans for eight nuclear reactors in the US, including Korean-made APR1400 units, signal expansion opportunities in the global nuclear energy sector.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's rental market is experiencing significant structural shifts, with monthly rent accounting for over 50% of all transactions, increasing tenant housing cost burdens by approximately 1 million won annually per 100 million won of jeonse deposits converted. Apartment supply is clustering around the 600 million won policy loan threshold, with national standard units reaching the 3 billion won price level in the Seoul metropolitan area. Rising construction costs, tightened lending standards, and lower-than-expected subscription rates for new apartments reflect growing affordability challenges in the residential market.
sections.International Economy: The NASDAQ reached record highs as semiconductor stocks rallied globally amid renewed investor optimism, despite US Federal Reserve rate hikes. The US-Iran diplomatic dialogue improvements contributed to international oil prices falling below $100 per barrel. The Fed's September rate increase to 3.75-4.00%, the first hike since July 2023, has sparked concerns about additional tightening, with multiple Fed officials issuing inflation warnings. US Treasury yield curve compression suggests growing market expectations of economic slowdown.
sections.AI & Economy: Chinese light manufacturing industries are incorporating AI and automation to shift from volume-based production to high-value brand-oriented models, with some sectors reporting revenues reaching 30 trillion yuan. Global investment trends are pivoting toward AI infrastructure and renewable energy, with stocks and REITs expected to perform well over the next five years. The autonomous vehicle market is projected to expand sixfold as electronic component requirements surge dramatically with advanced self-driving capabilities. JP Morgan estimates the AI agent market could eventually reach tens of trillions of dollars, comparable to annual US GDP.
sections.Others: Thailand's government decided to restrict cannabis legalization to medical use only, reversing its earlier blanket legalization policy, with penalties for unauthorized production and use. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has been suggested as a potential AI czar for the Trump administration. The US faces cautionary warnings about current AI capital investments reaching 3.5% of annual GDP, exceeding historical infrastructure development periods, with concerns about actual return-on-investment matching massive expenditures.
